   - No `helmet` middleware to set security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, CSP, etc.)

- Accidentally committed secrets
- Test credentials with real-looking formats that could be misused

The `/users` endpoint exposes PII (email addresses) with no authentication required.
